Meta-model learns conditional weights from validation windows; with unstable rankings (tau~0) this may outperform fixed inverse-error weighting by capturing which models shine in which regime.
Trimmed mean on top-7 SMAPE pool: robust to outlier model predictions while benefiting from excluding weakest models; tests whether subset+trim beats full-pool DBA under unstable ranking
Per-horizon topk (k=5, smape) on full pool: lets models rotate by horizon step, suited to unstable ranking and strong trend where best model shifts along the 12-step horizon

Robust median on top-7 RMSE pool: tests whether a smaller, focused pool with outlier-resistant aggregation beats full-pool DBA when ranking is unstable and errors are highly correlated (mean_corr 0.881).

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9792. Series context: trend strength 0.9708 and seasonal strength 0.5992; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.591.
